artworks.title: Apocalypse of John, Leaf 10
artworks.medium: woodcut on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting religious and mythical scenes. The image is divided into two main sections showing various figures and creatures. In the upper part, there is a haloed figure beside a building and several humanoid creatures with wings. Another haloed figure with long hair stands on the right side. In the lower part, a haloed figure stands to the left opposite a group of armored individuals on horseback charging towards a multi-headed beast with a spotted body. Latin inscriptions accompany the scenes. The line work is detailed yet simple, resembling medieval iconography.

artworks.title: Apocalypse of John, Leaf 42
artworks.medium: woodcut on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a medieval scene with text. The image depicts various medieval-style illustrations accompanied by Gothic script text. In one section, a figure sits on a throne-like chair with a raised hand. To the right, several figures rest beneath a canopy adorned with small figures. Below, there are knights in armor with pointed helmets. In the background, there is a cityscape with castle-like structures and a gathering scene in front of ornate architecture. The image is rendered in fine lines, resembling a woodcut, with detailed clothing, furnishings, and landscapes typical of medieval art.

artworks.title: The Last Agony of the Dying Man
artworks.medium: woodcut with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a religious scene. The image features various figures with halos surrounding a central crucifixion, backgrounded by a crucified figure on a cross. Angels are depicted in the upper portion, positioned above a figure with a staff who appears to be engaging with demon-like creatures below. Scrolls with gothic text are included throughout the scene. The detailed line work and stylization resemble medieval woodcuts, emphasizing a spiritual confrontation likely symbolic of the struggle between good and evil.

artworks.title: Massacre of the Firstborn and Egyptian Darkness
artworks.medium: hand-colored woodcut
artworks.description: This print shows two different vertical scenes placed next to each other. The left side shows a street scene framed by white buildings with red roofs. Several people lay on the street, and others look down at them through open windows or doors. The background of this print is white, and the people are dressed in bright red and green. In the scene on the right, a group of men in long robes and turbans approach a seated man on the left. They once again wear shades of green and red, and the throne or chair the man sits on has a green, white, and red design. The background of this print is black.

artworks.title: Page from "Canticum Canticorum": 2nd Edition
artworks.medium: woodcut (block book page) on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene featuring several figures and ornate text. The central figure appears to be a regal or sacred character standing in a room with a checkered floor. To the left, two figures are kneeling. To the right, two standing figures appear to be carrying objects. The walls of the room contain intricate decorations, including circular patterns and what could be windows or lattices. Above the figures, flowing ribbons of text wind through the composition. The style of the drawing includes flat, linear depictions with a focus on contour lines and minimal shading.

artworks.title: Page from "Canticum Canticorum": 2nd Edition
artworks.medium: woodcut (block book page) on laid paper
artworks.description: In this image, there are figures with stylized facial features. The primary scene on the left features two figures standing close together. One figure has a halo, while the other has a crown and halo. The figures appear to be interacting. Both figures are dressed in robes. Surrounding the scene are decorative banners with writing. On the right, there is an interior space with a patterned floor, a bed with a decorative cover, and curtains. Two additional figures in robes stand near the bed, looking towards a reclining figure's head. The entire image is framed with ornate script and patterns.

artworks.title: The Sacred Monograph with the Crucifixion  and Passion Symbols [recto]
artworks.medium: metalcut, hand-colored in light green, rose, and yellow on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crucifixion scene with ornate detailing. The image features a central crucifix, unfurling sun-like rays with an ornate 'IHS' emblem beneath. Surrounding emblematic religious icons and text enhance the spiritual theme, depicted alongside evocative floral and geometric patterns. The scene integrates historical religious art elements and symbolism within the intricate design.

artworks.title: Saint Catherine [verso]
artworks.medium: paste print on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows most of a person's body, from head to toe. The individual appears to be standing upright. Their facial features are not clearly defined due to the worn condition of the image. They are wearing a large crown adorned with points. The person has long hair cascading down their back and is dressed in a long, flowing garment with ornate detailing. In the person's hand, they seem to be holding a long staff or scepter. The background is texturized, with patterns and possible objects, though details are obscured. The image looks aged or weathered, with areas of discoloration and spots.

artworks.title: Saint Catherine
artworks.medium: paste print [counterproof] on laid paper
artworks.description: This print contains a series of irregular dark speckled patterns scattered across an off-white, rectangular background. No specific shapes or images are visible.

artworks.title: Fourteen Auxiliary Saints
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in pink-red, green, blue, and yellow
artworks.description: The image consists of fifteen rectangular panels, each featuring a full-body depiction of a religious or historical figure. The figures are shown in standing poses with different items or symbols. They have simplified facial features, various hairstyles, and wear robes in muted colors. Some figures are depicted with crowns, halos, armor, swords, or staffs. Symbols like a crucifix, a lamb, and lions can be seen around them. Several figures wear headpieces and hold items such as palm leaves, crosses, or chalices. The background of each panel is plain, emphasizing the figures with their distinctive attributes and adornments.

artworks.title: The Transportation of the Holy House of Loreto
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in tan, dark gray-green, orange, and purple; the green and orange may have been applied by means of a stencil
artworks.description: This is a painting depicting towering cityscapes labeled Nazareth and Jerusalem, with a church being carried through the heavens by two angels. A checkerboard pattern is partially visible in the foreground. A radiant figure emerges from clouds in the upper section of the image, framed by intricate design elements with text in ribbon-like banners. The style is reminiscent of a medieval or early Renaissance illustration, with earthy and muted colors accented by traditional bright colors like reds, blues, and greens. The piece likely illustrates a religious event or story and resembles an illustrative woodcut from religious texts of that period.

artworks.title: Christ on the Cross with the Virgin and Saint John
artworks.medium: colored woodcut on vellum
artworks.description: The image depicts three figures. The central figure is on a cross, with arms outstretched. He has long dark hair, a beard, and wears a crown of thorns and cloth. On each side of the cross, there is another figure. The figure on the left has their head tilted down, wearing a robe with a veil. The figure on the right has golden curly hair, a tunic, and a cloak. Both figures have halos. The background shows abstract patterns suggesting the sky and hills in blue and white. At the bottom, there is a line of Latin text.

artworks.title: Song to the Madonna
artworks.medium: woodcut
artworks.description: The image depicts a religious seated figure with accompanying text. The central illustration shows a crowned, robed figure holding a smaller robed figure on a throne-like chair. The surrounding text is in a gothic script style, with floral and vine-like borders on either side. The top part of the image includes a decorative heading in a fancy font. The paper looks aged and has a sepia tone, giving it an antique look.

artworks.title: Border from an Almanac
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in green, brown, rose, and yellow
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a historical illuminated text page. The page features two columns of printed Latin text. Along the left side of the page is a decorative border with botanical motifs and figures colored in green, yellow, and pink. The calligraphic banner along the top of the page contains intricate medieval manuscript style text. The document suggests an origin in the early print period.

artworks.title: The Nativity
artworks.medium: woodcut on laid paper

artworks.title: Crowned Man on a Throne with the Virgin Standing at the left
artworks.medium: hand-colored woodcut
artworks.description: The image shows a seated man wearing a crown and a red robe with black patterns. He sits on a throne, with his right hand raised, index finger extended. Beside him stands a person with light hair, a headband, and brown clothing, gesturing. The scene is set in an architectural setting with green drapery behind the throne and a background of brick wall or steps leading to a landscape. On the right, there is vertical, dark Gothic script.

artworks.title: The Crucifixion
artworks.medium: woodcut on vellum touched with red
artworks.description: The image depicts a crucifixion scene with a city in the background. A central figure on a cross is flanked by two smaller figures. The background shows a cityscape with buildings and towers. Above the central figure, an inscription reads 'INRI.' A dark sun and a crescent moon are in the sky. At the foot of the cross, there is a skull and bone. Intricate decorative patterns frame the scene.

artworks.title: Christ as the Man of Sorrows
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in red lake, yellow ochre, tan, and green
artworks.description: The image shows an illustration of a person sitting upright in a stone structure. The person has a thin face, gentle eyes, and long dark hair. They are wearing a yellow cloth around the lower body, with their chest exposed showing stigmata. A halo is around their head. In the background are various items including a yellow cross, ropes, tools, a rooster, a sword, an axe, and a leafy branch. An inset image of two figures is on the left, with a bucket hanging from the wall. The illustration uses earthy colors against a plain background.

artworks.title: Christ in the Wine Press
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in burgundy red, pink, dull green, dull orange, brown, tan and white on laid paper

artworks.title: Saint Anne, The Madonna and Child and Saints Christopher, Sebastian, Clara and Roche
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in blue, yellow, and cinnamon
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a religious tableau with medieval text. The artwork features five distinct religious scenes within rectangular frames. The top displays ornate Gothic script text, which reads "Iesvs Nazarenvs Rex Ivdeorvm." Below, there are five illustrated panels: St. Christopher carrying Jesus across a river; a saintly figure pierced with arrows; a nativity-like scene with Jesus, Maria, and Anna; a crowned female figure in a pastoral landscape; and a bearded figure resting with a staff. The style resembles medieval woodcuts or illuminated manuscripts, with bold outlines and a limited color palette of earth tones. The figures are detailed with symbolic attire and gestures.

artworks.title: Saints Christopher, Sebastian, and Roche
artworks.medium: woodcut
artworks.description: This is a drawing of medieval scenes. The image is divided into sections, each featuring detailed depictions of figures engaged in various activities. On the left side, a figure is carrying a figure across a body of water, with an elaborate background of stylized trees and other foliage. In the middle, a figure is shown drawing a bow, aiming at another figure who appears to be restrained. To the right, a figure holds an object aloft while another kneels, engaged in a ceremonial or ritualistic act. The drawing style is intricate, with an emphasis on patterns and ornamentation reminiscent of medieval art from the 15th century.

artworks.title: Saint Francis Receiving the Stigmata
artworks.medium: woodcut
artworks.description: This is a print of a religious scene featuring two people and a winged being above them. The two people are seated on the ground. One person wears a long robe and a hood; they are seated on the ground among some small plants and look down at a book in their hands. The other person is looking upwards towards the sky, where a winged creature with human-like features is depicted hovering above them. This creature is directing several beams or cords of light towards the person’s hands and feet. The person on the ground wears a robe tied with a cord around their waist and has a halo around their head. In the background, there is a church-like building on the right, and on the left, there are hills or mountains with a small, distant village visible.

artworks.title: Christ on the Cross
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in brown lake, tan, green, and black
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crucifixion scene. The central figure is mounted on a cross with visible wounds depicted by red lines. Surrounding the central figure are several other figures with varied expressions and postures. The figures are dressed in different attire and headwear. The scene is set against a muted background with hints of green at the bottom. The drawing style is linear and contour-oriented with minimal shading and color accents mainly in earth tones and dull greens.

artworks.title: Saint Michael
artworks.medium: hand-colored woodcut
artworks.description: This is a painting of an angelic figure standing over a defeated entity. The angelic figure is depicted in a victorious pose, holding a shield with the initials "IHS" inscribed on it. The defeated entity lies beneath, surrounded by vibrant orange and red hues. The celestial figure is garbed in intricate robes with highlights of green. Movement is conveyed through the dynamic lines and patterns within the wings and surrounding elements. The background contains abstract shapes and patterns. The stylistic approach resembles medieval religious iconography, emphasizing symbolic representation over realism.
